title: Meet the Author
text: meet the author Caroline Gwynne J OHN G WYNNE studied and lectured at Brighton University. He has played double bass in a rock ’n’ roll band and traveled the United States and Canada. He is married with four children and lives in Eastbourne, where he is part of a Viking reenactment group. When not writing, he can often be found standing in a shield wall with his three sons about him. His dogs think he is their slave.
